set -e; EXPECTED=78b41c0e3eddaa82b69a846b03ceb4db2483e312; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'; }; BT_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; }; trap cleanup EXIT; test "$(state)" = 0; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager disable >/dev/null; fi; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(state)" = 2 ] && break; sleep 1; done; test "$(state)" = 2; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_shizuku_call_end_probe true --el call_end_wait_ms 120000 >/tmp/aicall-callend-v2.start 2>&1; grep -q 'Status: ok' /tmp/aicall-callend-v2.start; HELPER=''; for i in $(seq 1 100); do HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -n "$HELPER" ] && break; sleep 0.1; done; test -n "$HELPER"; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/s22_call_end_gate.py --serial "$SERIAL" arm --helper-pid "$HELPER"; DONE=0; for i in $(seq 1 1500); do if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell test -f /data/local/tmp/aicall_callend_observer.txt >/dev/null 2>&1; then DONE=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; test "$DONE" = 1; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/s22_call_end_gate.py --serial "$SERIAL" collect --max-cleanup-ms 3000; RESULT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null || true); printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'call_end_fail_safe_ok=true'; test "$(state)" = 0; echo milestone_d_natural_call_end_green=true; cleanup; trap - EXIT; if [ "$BT_BEFORE" = 1 ]; then for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1 ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; fi; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "$BT_BEFORE"
